FULL TEXT:
Shri Mata Vaishno Devi University
SMVDU/R&D/19/583 Date: 18/09/2019
Subject: Advertisement for the position of JRF/SRF/RA in CSIR funded Project
Applications on plain paper are invited for the 01 position of JRF/SRF/RA in CSIR funded Research project entitled
“A STUDY OF ORLICZ SEQUENCE SPACES AND THEIR OPERATORS”
Project Investigator (PI): Dr. Kuldip Raj, Assistant Professor, School of Mathematics, SMVDU Katra,
Email: kuldeep.raj@smvdu.ac.in Mobile 9419131961
Position Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Senior Research Fellow (SRF) / Researh Associateship (RA) - 01
Essential
qualifications
JRF – Candidate with M. Sc. degree in Mathematics with NET/GATE qualification
SRF – Candidate with M. Sc. in Mathematics with at least 55% marks and One publication in SCI
Journals and should have completed at least two years of Post M. Sc. Research Experience
RA – Candidate having Ph. D (Mathematics) with three years R&D experience as on the last date of
application. Candidate who have submitted Ph. D thesis are also eligible for RA’ship. Selection in
such cases will be subject to the condition that Ph. D viva-voce done & declared qualified for the
award of PhD/awarded PhD degree before the expiry of the validity of the award offer. Candidate
must have at least one research publication in Standard referred Journals as listed in Journal Citation
Reports (JCR)
Other important
information
The selected candidate may register for Ph. D degree at School of Mathematics, SMVDU upon
meeting the eligibility criteria.
Duration The duration of the project is 03 years and the position is purely temporary / co-terminus with the
duration of the project.
Emoluments JRF @ 31,000/- PM fixed for first two years and @ 35,000/- PM fixed for third year for NET/GATE
qualified Candidate.
SRF @ 35,000/- PM fixed for three years
RA @ 47,000/- PM fixed for three years
Age Limit JRF – Upper Age Limit (28 years).
SRF - Upper Age Limit (32 years).
RA - Upper Age Limit (35 years).
The upper age limit is relaxable upto 5 years in case of applicants belonging to Scheduled Castes /
Scheduled Tribes / Physically handicapped and Women applicants and 3 years for OBC applicants.
How to apply Eligible candidates may apply with full details on plain paper (incuding qualifications, Email iD
contact number stating “application for JRF /SRF/ RA” with a copy of Bio-data and required
certificates so as to reach the undersigned within two weeks of this advertisement through post or
email (kuldeep.raj@smvdu.ac.in)
Important
Information
Shortlisted candidates as per CSIR guidelines may be called for Interview. Interview date will be
intimated to shortlisted candidates. No Travelling allowance will be provided to shortlisted candidates.
No further communication in this matter will be entertained.
Dr. Kuldip Raj
PI, RP 102
